name: Shuthelah
overview: Shuthelah is a biblical figure identified as a son of Ephraim, with his lineage detailed in Numbers 26 and 1 Chronicles 7. Scripture highlights Shuthelah as the progenitor of the family of the Shuthalhites and records his descendants, including Eran and Zabad, emphasizing the continuation of Ephraim's family line. These genealogical records underscore God's faithfulness in preserving the tribes of Israel through successive generations.
